description:
Get the full verified rule record for one route.

Slugs are lowercase country slugs as used on petimportguide.com (e.g. from_slug='united-states', to_slug='japan'); pet is 'dog', 'cat', 'ferret' or 'bird'. The record includes the checklist, timeline, costs, official sources and the date the rules were last verified.
name: get_route
title: Get pet import rules for one route
